name: rasta-commerce
description: Quality tooling for the Rasta Commerce WordPress theme.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:php && npm run test:gateway && npm run test:jalali && npm run test:elementor && npm run test:admin && npm run test:customizer && npm run test:maintenance && npm run test:store && npm run test:notifications && npm run test:welcome && npm run test:builder
scripts.package: npm run package:theme && npm run package:child && npm run package:core && npm run package:zarinpal
scripts.marketplace:prepare: npm run package && node scripts/package-marketplace.mjs prepare
scripts.marketplace:build: npm run marketplace:prepare && node scripts/package-marketplace.mjs build
